## Template — Presentation Assembler

Assemble slides/charts from **already extracted** report facts — do not re-run cluster jobs or re-parse binaries.

Prefer deterministic assembly (Calc-style adapter). Clone `Template — Engineering Specialist` only if narrative layout needs an LLM, and keep tools allowlisted.

Output: `deliverables` + `artifact_refs` (pptx/png/html) + `compact_data.presentation_compact` (slide index / chart specs).
